article.title: The Most Valuable AI Use Case May Be the Boring One
article.author: OpenAI learning editor
article.why: 從 ROI、頻率、可驗證性與營運風險角度，理解為什麼例行工作常比華麗 use case 更適合先導入 AI。

paragraphs.en: Organizations often search for an impressive AI use case. They imagine autonomous agents, complex forecasting, or systems that replace a long chain of human work. These projects can create value, but they also require integration, governance, monitoring, and organizational change. In many companies, the first use case with the best return may be something much more ordinary.
paragraphs.zh: 組織常在尋找看起來很厲害的 AI use case，例如 autonomous agent、複雜預測，或能取代長串人工流程的系統。這些確實可能創造價值，但也需要更多整合、治理、監控與組織變革。很多企業最先能拿到最好 ROI 的，反而可能是很普通的任務。
paragraphs.ja: 企業は自律エージェントや高度予測のような目立つAI活用を探しがちですが、最初に高いROIを出すのは地味な業務かもしれません。

paragraphs.en: A boring use case has several advantages. It happens frequently, the inputs are familiar, the expected output is clear, and employees already know how to review the result. Examples include summarizing standard meeting notes, drafting first versions of routine emails, classifying common requests, extracting fields from documents, or preparing a checklist from a known template. None of these tasks sounds revolutionary, but small savings can accumulate when the task is repeated thousands of times.
paragraphs.zh: 所謂無聊 use case 有幾個優點：高頻、輸入熟悉、輸出清楚、員工也已知道怎麼 review。例如標準會議紀錄摘要、例行郵件初稿、常見請求分類、文件欄位抽取、或依既有模板建立 checklist。單次看起來不革命性，但若每天重複上千次，小幅節省也會累積成大價值。
paragraphs.ja: 地味なユースケースには、高頻度、入力が既知、期待出力が明確、人が確認しやすいという利点があります。定型議事録の要約、メール下書き、問い合わせ分類、文書からの項目抽出などです。

paragraphs.en: Frequency matters because return on investment is not only about how much time one use saves. It is the saving per use multiplied by the number of uses, minus implementation and review costs. A dramatic task that happens twice a year may create less value than a simple task performed every day by hundreds of employees. Reviewability matters too. AI is easier to deploy when humans can quickly tell whether the output is acceptable.
paragraphs.zh: ROI 不只看一次省多少時間，而是每次節省乘上使用次數，再扣掉導入與 review 成本。一年只做兩次的華麗任務，可能比每天由數百人執行的簡單任務更沒價值。Reviewability 也很重要，人類若能快速判斷 AI 輸出是否合理，導入會更容易。
paragraphs.ja: ROIは一回の時間削減だけでなく、削減量×利用回数から導入・レビューコストを引いて考える必要があります。年二回の華やかな作業より、毎日数百人が行う単純作業の方が価値を生むことがあります。

paragraphs.en: Routine use cases also help organizations build operational muscles. Teams learn how to manage access, protect data, monitor quality, record incidents, and decide when humans should intervene. These capabilities are reusable. A company that successfully governs a modest tool is often better prepared for more autonomous systems later. It also creates evidence about actual usage instead of relying only on demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 例行 use case 還能幫組織建立營運能力：權限、資料保護、品質監控、incident 記錄與人工介入條件。這些能力之後可以重複使用。成功治理一個小型工具的企業，往往更能準備好未來較 autonomous 的系統，也能取得真實使用證據，而不是只看 demo。
paragraphs.ja: 定型業務での導入を通じて、権限、データ保護、品質監視、インシデント記録、人の介入条件など運用能力を育てられます。これらは後の高度なAIにも使えます。

paragraphs.en: There is a counterargument. Starting with small tasks can produce only small improvements and may cause leaders to underestimate AI’s strategic potential. That risk is real. The answer is to separate the adoption path from the ambition level. A company can maintain an ambitious long-term vision while using lower-risk tasks to learn how deployment actually works.
paragraphs.zh: 反方意見是：只做小事會讓管理層低估 AI 戰略潛力。這確實可能發生。因此要把導入路徑與長期野心分開。長期可以很 ambitious，但第一步仍可用低風險任務建立能力。
paragraphs.ja: 小さな活用だけでは戦略的可能性を過小評価するという反論もあります。そのため、長期ビジョンと導入順序を分けて考えることが重要です。

paragraphs.en: Managers should therefore evaluate AI use cases with a portfolio view. They can score frequency, time saved, error cost, review difficulty, integration effort, data sensitivity, and strategic learning value. The highest-value project may not have the most impressive demonstration. It may be the one that solves a repetitive problem, produces measurable savings, and teaches the organization how to operate AI safely.
paragraphs.zh: 管理者應以 portfolio 方式評估 use case：頻率、節省時間、錯誤成本、review 難度、整合成本、資料敏感度與策略學習價值。最有價值的專案未必 demo 最華麗，而可能是能解決高頻問題、量化節省，並教會組織如何安全營運 AI 的那一個。
paragraphs.ja: AIユースケースは、頻度、時間削減、誤りコスト、レビュー難易度、統合負荷、データ機密性、学習価値を含むポートフォリオとして評価すべきです。

paragraphs.en: The broader lesson is that transformation often begins with ordinary work. Reliable value from boring tasks can create trust, data, and governance practices that make more advanced automation possible. In that sense, the boring use case is not a distraction from AI strategy. It can be the foundation of it.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的轉型常從普通工作開始。穩定的小成果能累積信任、資料與治理能力，最後成為更進階自動化的基礎。無聊 use case 並不是偏離 AI strategy，反而可能正是它的 foundation。
paragraphs.ja: 地味な活用が、より高度な自動化の基盤になることがあります。AI戦略から外れているのではなく、その土台になり得ます。

quiz.question: Why can a boring use case have a better ROI?
quiz.answer: Because it may occur frequently, be easy to review, and have lower integration and risk costs.

quiz.question: Output: propose one boring AI use case from your work and explain why it is valuable.
quiz.answer: Discuss frequency, time saved, reviewability, and risk.

interpretation.label: 核心
interpretation.text: AI ROI 很大一部分來自 frequency × saving − review/integration cost。

interpretation.label: 策略
interpretation.text: 低風險 use case 可作為治理與營運能力的訓練場。
